components.summary: Group related content in a themed surface with filled, outline, subtle, and alternative appearances plus compact, medium, large, and horizontal layouts. Selectable cards provide a themed, keyboard-operable checkbox with controlled or default selection. Nonselectable cards support off, no-tab, tab-exit, and tab-only focus modes. SharePointCard remains available as an alias.
